name: Jam n' Limit ~Mis/shitsu/Kan/kin
original_name: ジャムアンリミット～密/室/監/禁
source:
Ever since I was a child, I had always questioned myself. Yes, I’ve always hated those so-called moral lessons. “Do not hate or harm others. Try to be mindful of other people’s feelings. Plants and animals are living beings too, so treat them kindly.” I wonder if there is anyone who actually puts these lessons in practice?

To begin with, it is impossible for one person to adequately understand the feelings of another person. Also, treat other living things kindly, they say? Should such a line come from someone who eats meat? Who gave them the right to preach such hypocritical nonsense?

Even if I were to narrow down the topic to human beings…for example, a person who raises funds for the sake of the homeless or those in greater need…I wonder if they’re as great as they seem to be.
Helping elderly people cross the street, giving directions to those who ask, offering your seat on the bus or train… wouldn’t that be nothing more than feeding one’s superiority complex, feeling of self-satisfaction, or just your typical social propaganda?

Considering that I ponder these issues on a daily basis, I’m quite certain that society would just say I’m “going crazy”. However, as far as I’m concerned, this is completely “normal” to me.

If the world is to think that I’ve gone crazy, then I must prove that they are the ones who have gone mad. Thus, I shall find a suitable target for this “experiment”, to show the world that I am the one who is normal.

From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url].
translation:
从小时候起，我就一直心存疑问。没错，我始终厌恶那些所谓的道德教诲。“不要憎恨或伤害他人，要体谅别人的感受。植物和动物同样是生命，所以也要善待它们。”世上真的有人身体力行这些教诲吗？

说到底，一个人根本不可能充分理解另一个人的感受。至于善待其他生物？这种话也配从吃肉的人口中说出来吗？是谁给了他们权利，让他们宣扬这套虚伪的废话？

即便把话题缩小到人类身上……譬如那些为无家可归者或处境更加困难的人募款的人……他们真的像表面看起来那般伟大吗？
扶老人过马路、为问路的人指明方向、在公共汽车或列车上让座……这些行为难道不只是在满足优越感与自我陶醉，或不过是司空见惯的社会宣传吗？

鉴于我每天都在思考这些问题，我很确定社会只会说我“正在发疯”。然而在我看来，这一切对我而言都完全“正常”。

既然全世界都认为我疯了，我就必须证明真正发疯的是他们。因此，我要为这场“实验”寻找合适的对象，向世人证明正常的那个人是我。
